analysis.purpose: A disposable, gitignored full-text index over memory records, supplying the lexical relevance signal that recall ranks with — deliberately separate from the code search index.
responsibilities: Maintain a derived full-text read model over memory records
Supply lexical scores to the recall core through its port
Stay disposable: rebuildable at any time and never committed

businessRules.rule: Kept deliberately separate from the code search index rather than sharing one.
businessRules.rationale: Memory and code are different corpora; one index would blur their ranking and lifecycles.

nodes.summary: Derived lexical index over memory records.
